messages:
mara: Heads-up: thinking about a quiet rollout mode that routes /v1/generate -> /v2/generate but keeps invoices showing "origin" for 14 days. Thoughts?
jonathan: 👍 billing will want a clear field. propose `origin_version` + `routed_version` on invoice rows, CSV export too.
ash: router can add header `X-RW-Origin` when we auto-route. easiest place is right before usage ping.
sam: Important: add a console toggle per-route "Keep origin on invoices (14d)" and an opt-in for tenants.
ella-ux: UI: small banner on route page: "Quiet rollout enabled: invoices will show origin for 14 days." and an invoice expand to show origin/routed columns.
mara: Rollout: dry-run -> quiet-rollout (invoices keep origin) -> full flip. guardrails: p95 +20% or token_inflation +25% triggers auto-stop.
jonathan: Also emit metric `routing.origin_invoiced_count` and link it to the rollouts dashboard.
deploy-bot: (system) queued: quiet-rollout-canary 1795555555 -> will post canary summary here.
